changed_boundary: Replace external guessed timing with actual original publication notification plus one existing-state cold read.
documentation_correction: c66c described 500ms between-frame idle too broadly. The original HAP exchange waits for its first byte under the original owner lifetime, then bounds the in-flight exchange by timeout. This successor does not change that implementation; only the initial readiness wait is explicitly clamped to the same startup deadline.
future_tests: Meaningful mechanism cases and exact registration delta are a separate successor; no existing test success is claimed.
not_authority: The latch and wire echo are scheduling only. Root checks the same current Source/Cell before the hint and again on every actual data request; the consumer checks actual fixed publication after the authenticated exchange. The protected supervisor disclosure and original Generator/trust authentication remain separate requirements.
preserved: Original HAP peer/UID/pidfd and f42 refusal
Same one-use Material host and same private task/session/custody Arcs
Same original Source, Cell and Current owners
Original daemon Driver/AutomationStore/Receipt and Source publication body
Same 128 total frames, same absolute ends, no reconnection or retry
Every prefreeze/material data read remains original-current authenticated
refusal_limits: Premature Source Missing/Pending waits once; changed, withdrawn, invalid or unavailable Source refuses.
A publication that became durable before a later failure can remain unknown without a hint. Existing-state cold readback can later inspect it, never redispatch.
The original synchronous Source/Cell read can overrun a deadline; postchecks reject success, not prove physical cancellation.
A blocked wait samples the peer before and after; it does not promise immediate peer-exit wake before its bounded common startup deadline.
No full daemon/Root process-cold execution or ordinary Material CLI run has been observed.
status: Fixed source proposal only; no formatting, compilation, tests, collector or H.
